documents.title: Annual report extract
documents.text:
Annual report extract: Brennick Healthcare (fictional, authored test material).
For Brennick Ltd, cash on balance sheet in FY2024 was $49.7m (reported basis). Free cash flow at Brennick Healthcare stood at approximately $17.5m in FY2024 (reported basis). Brennick Healthcare had senior leverage of 5.3x in FY2024. For Brennick Healthcare, recurring revenue share in FY2023 was 86.3%. The covenant cure mechanism for Brennick Healthcare is understood as follows: cure by equity injection counted only as debt reduction. As to Brennick Healthcare, the security package is: unsecured, ranking pari passu with trade creditors.

documents.text:
Quarterly lender update: Brennick Healthcare (fictional, authored test material).
For Brennick Limited, cash on balance sheet in FY2024 was $40.6m (reported basis). Operating expenses at Brennick Healthcare stood at $113.6m in FY2025 (reported basis). Brennick Healthcare had gross debt of USD 398.4 million in FY2024 (reported basis). For Brennick Healthcare, recurring revenue share in FY2025 was 61.2%. The covenant cure mechanism for Brennick Healthcare is understood as follows: cure by equity injection counted as EBITDA.
